parse_u64.scope: Manual inspection of the complete generated function and headers on the measured C++17 platform
parse_u64.notes: Uses a local accumulator, validates ASCII digit bounds before subtraction, and tests value <= (UINT64_MAX-digit)/10 before multiply/add. High-bit bytes are rejected under either signed-char or unsigned-char interpretation on the measured ASCII platform. Assigns out only on complete success; no locale, allocation or exception operations.

parse_u64_4k.scope: Manual inspection of the complete generated function and headers on the measured C++17 platform
parse_u64_4k.notes: Casts bytes to unsigned char and validates ASCII digit bounds; checks UINT64_MAX quotient/remainder constants before multiply/add. Uses a local accumulator and assigns out only on success. Rejects empty input, signs, spaces, NUL and high-bit bytes; no allocation, locale or exception operations.

parse_u64.scope: Manual inspection of the complete generated function and headers on the measured C++17 platform
parse_u64.notes: Validates ASCII digit bounds before subtraction and checks value <= (UINT64_MAX-digit)/10 before multiply/add. High-bit chars fail under signed or unsigned char on the measured ASCII platform. Uses a local accumulator and assigns out only after complete success; no allocation, locale or exception operations.

parse_u64_4k.scope: Manual inspection of the complete generated function and headers on the measured C++17 platform
parse_u64_4k.notes: Reads through an unsigned-char view of the valid string_view buffer, checks ASCII digits and quotient/remainder cutoffs before every multiply/add. Overflow sets a sticky flag; subsequent arithmetic is still guarded and the function returns false without assigning out. Empty and invalid bytes fail, and no allocations, locale or exception operations occur.
